title: Document
referenceError: The source reference could not be opened. Check that the file is inside this workspace.
openError: This document cannot be opened. Use a local HTML file inside an open workspace folder.
chooseSource: Open an HTML source file, then run Preview HTML Document.
reopenError: This document could not be restored. Reopen its workspace folder and use its saved document link.

errors.scope: Document access is outside the open workspace. Reopen its original workspace folder.
errors.missing: Source file is missing or unreadable. Restore it at the original path to recover this preview.
errors.path: Use a local .html or .htm file inside the workspace.
errors.size: Document exceeds viewer limits (512 KiB, 12,000 elements, 64 levels or 32 widgets). Reduce its size. The parsing time limit may also have been exceeded.
errors.version: This document needs alpha-document version 1. Correct its version marker to recover the preview.
errors.reference: A source reference is malformed. Use a workspace-relative path and a positive line number.
errors.data: Widget data contains an invalid number. Correct the source to recover the preview.
errors.format: Document needs a title and one main.alpha-doc element with data-alpha-kit="1". Correct the source to recover the preview.

panelLimit: Close an HTML document preview before opening another. Up to eight previews can be open at once.
